RetainedRouteEvidence.Meaning: Four existing E1M1-E1M4 route regressions and E1M2-E1M4 fixed-input replays remain the retained regression set. The renderer-only e8ffd6e source change leaves the gameplay and input replay code unchanged.

KnownLimits: No human has completed the requested Episode 1 playthrough yet; the handoff requests one full run, not map-by-map tests.
Transition and boss fixtures verify state changes but do not claim ordinary playthroughs of E1M5-E1M8 or the finale.

The E1M3 waypoint driver previously stopped short of its next point without a crash or reproducible product defect; route tuning is stopped. Its retained 7,118-command fixed-input replay reaches E1M4 with all checkpoints matching.
Whole-campaign music continuity, audible review, and physical keyboard play have not been certified; a prior finite audio-device run recorded one queue-timing stall.
Sustained 35 simulation tics/sec and 60 displayed updates/sec are not certified.

Renderer comparisons are against the adopted PowerShell renderer. Original-executable pixel parity is unverified, and the tic-105 actor visibility difference plus broader scene differences remain open fidelity work.
Notes: The candidate fixes a reproducible actor-occlusion error: floor/ceiling fill pixels had been written into the depth buffer even though Doom draws planes as backgrounds. An attempted sector-visibility cull was removed after it broke serial/worker strip equality. No bot or recording run was used for this readiness decision.
